about: The cousins the mod can dress the player as, one entry each. 'styles' maps a style key to its .llcm file, relative to this folder (format in FORMAT.md). 'icons' maps a style key to her select-screen icon (a PNG made by Tools/render_icons.py), relative to this folder. 'build' is read only by Tools/export_llcm.py and Tools/check_llcm.py; its paths are relative to the LongLostCousins folder.

cousins.name: Burda
cousins.notes: Cousin 26 of the cancelled Katamari Damacy Online, a singer whose head is a sideways microphone. Both styles use OUAK's 23 joint names and rest at identity. The new style has a piece for each of OUAK's 23 face slots plus her singing eyes; the old style shows one of 11 face cards. The old style plays OUAK's motions for now, with her waist 7.415 cm higher than the Prince's.
